title: NYSE to Launch 24/7 Trading Platform for Blockchain-Based Securities
text: The New York Stock Exchange said Monday that it was developing a platform for trading tokenized securities, putting the heft of the 233-year-old exchange behind Wall Street’s growing embrace of the technology behind bitcoin.  The NYSE said it would seek regulatory approval for the new platform, which companies could use to issue securities that are represented as digital tokens on a blockchain, similar to the way cryptocurrencies work.  Like crypto exchanges, the new platform would offer 24/7 trading, the NYSE said.
